propositions: Operator-attested evidence must declare measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) on an indented continuation line to force context into the record and enable repo-grounded contradiction detection
A deterministic check must validate presence and non-placeholder values of all four provenance fields and enum membership for privilege_posture and instrument, making no judgment about correctness

An AGENT-tier criterion must judge declared environment against in-repo IaC anchors (e.g., Terraform backend account), broader privilege posture on scoped permissions, and instrument type for authorization claims
Existing [operator-attested] criteria lacking provenance fields must be grandfathered as advisory coaching strings, not blocking, to prevent migration breaks
The rubric prompt must declare execution_mode: agentic to grant filesystem tooling for reading infra/ anchors and performing the contradiction probe
